items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: so he joined the union and start working with us and in four or five days he was working.

ctx.x: ....he always was laughing and a good nature, so we was working in La Conga, so he just came and say: "Hello" ha, ha, ha, you know, laughing thing, and he says --- Well, and the next day we went to the union, on account that he was resident. Everything, everything was in order and Mario had a good reputation, we had a good reputation in the Union so he joined the union and start working with us and in four or five days he was working.
So it took him a week before he got to work with your band.
